name: 左窄品牌欄＋右數欄連結群組＋全寬分隔底部列
desc: 左側窄欄放標誌與圖示連結、右側數欄連結群組並排的頁尾，底部列上方有一條橫跨畫面的分隔線。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。左右分成兩區，內容對齊頁面內容寬度，各欄靠上對齊：左側約兩成是品牌區，最左一窄欄上方放標誌、欄底放一排小圖示連結，圖示橫向排成一列不換行，放在欄的底部，與最長一欄連結群組的底部對齊；標誌右側可再放一窄欄，是一個小標題，下方為一個小旗幟圖示加一行小字，沒有外框，沒有時省略；右側約八成是數欄並排的連結群組，每組是一個小標題加上直向排列的文字連結，連結下可再縮排一層子連結，沒有時省略。最下方一列是底部列，上方有一條橫跨整個畫面寬、貼齊畫面左右邊緣的分隔線：一行小字靠左，另一側可放一行次要文字加一排等大的小圖示，沒有時省略，其他元素位置不變。
mobile: 左右兩區改為上下排列：最上方一列是標誌靠左、一排小圖示連結靠右；其下是小標題與小旗幟圖示加一行小字。再往下是連結群組，直向堆疊並靠左，每組之間有一條橫向分隔線；前兩組連結群組預設展開、全部顯示連結，其餘群組改為收合清單，點小標題後展開該組連結，收合的小標題右側有向下箭頭。底部列上方的分隔線保留並橫跨畫面寬，底部列改為上下堆疊並靠左：次要文字與小圖示在上，小圖示可自動換行，一行小字在最下方。沒有動態效果。

en.name: Narrow brand column + multi-column link groups + full-width divided bottom bar
en.desc: A footer with a narrow left column for the logo and icon links and several columns of link groups side by side on the right, with a divider spanning the viewport above the bottom bar.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. It is split into two areas aligned to the page content width, with every column top-aligned: the left area, about two tenths, is the brand block, where the leftmost narrow column holds the logo at the top and a row of small icon links at the bottom of the column, laid out in a single horizontal row without wrapping and aligned with the bottom of the longest link group column; optionally place another narrow column to the right of the logo containing a group heading with a small flag icon and a line of small text below it, with no outline or box, and omit it when there is no content. The right area, about eight tenths, holds several columns of link groups side by side, each a group heading followed by vertically stacked text links; optionally indent one level of sub-links under a link, and omit them when there is no content. At the very bottom is the bottom bar, with a divider above it spanning the full viewport width, flush with the left and right edges of the viewport: a line of small text on the left; optionally place a line of secondary text and a row of equally sized small icons on the other side; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements.
en.mobile: The two areas stack vertically: the top row has the logo on the left and the row of small icon links on the right; below it are the group heading with the small flag icon and line of small text. Further down, the link groups stack vertically, left-aligned, with a horizontal divider between groups; the first two link groups are expanded by default with all links shown, and the remaining groups become an accordion where tapping a group heading expands its links, with a downward arrow on the right of each collapsed group heading. The divider above the bottom bar is kept and still spans the full viewport width; the bottom bar stacks vertically and left-aligned: the secondary text and small icons on top, with the icons allowed to wrap, and the line of small text at the very bottom. There is no motion.
